title: A temperature class
description:
Write a class with properties that check their values.

```
20 °C is 68 °F
Cannot go below absolute zero (-273.15 °C)
```
hints: Keep a private field `_celsius` behind the property, and check `value` in the setter (lesson 3.01).
`public double Fahrenheit { get => Celsius * 9 / 5 + 32; set => Celsius = (value - 32) * 5 / 9; }` keeps the check in one place.
requirements: `class Temperature` with a `Celsius` property whose setter throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` below -273.15.
`Fahrenheit` is a property with a getter and a setter that converts through `Celsius`.
stretch: Make `Temperature` a `readonly record struct` instead, with `With` methods that return new values.
